WEB-721 (R1H-1) · Opening the demo with no connection says ‘What you said is kept, and trying again won’t cost an extra try.’ before the visitor has said anything (render `voice-connect-offline.en.mobile.light.panel.png`; AUDIT §13:973-974). Cause: `statusFailed` (`VoiceDemo.tsx:309-316`) maps every non-`Refused` reason to `t.errors.offline`, the sending message. Fix: add `offlineOpening` to `voice.errors` in `src/content/site/types.ts` (right after `offline`, with the comment `// Opening the demo with no connection: nothing has been said yet.`) and in the three content files: EN `No connection. Check Wi-Fi or mobile data and try again.` / ES `No hay conexión. Revisa el wifi o los datos móviles e inténtalo de nuevo.` / CA `No hi ha connexió. Revisa la wifi o les dades mòbils i torna-ho a provar.` (each is exactly the first two sentences of that language's `errors.offline`). In `statusFailed`, the non-`Refused` branch becomes `{ message: t.errors.offlineOpening }`. `errors.offline` stays exactly as it is and is still used by `submit`'s catch (`:507`) for a send that fails offline.

WEB-722 (R1H-2) · ‘3 of 3 tries left’ shows in the panel header when the demo can't be used: the `off` stage (demo paused; render `voice-error-budget-pause.en.mobile.light.panel.png`) and the `unverified` stage (security check failed twice; `voice-check-gave-up.en.mobile.light.panel.png`). Fix: in the badge (`:705-712`), show the count only when `status` is set and `stage` is neither `"off"` nor `"unverified"`; otherwise show the existing `t.liveDemo` (`Live demo` / `Demo en directo` / `Demo en directe`), as the connecting state already does. The developer-testing text keeps its priority. No new string.

WEB-723 (R1H-3) · After the security check fails a second time, the alert and Try again disappear and the static example appears with only the hand-over under it; nothing on screen or announced says why, and the example could be read as a result (render `voice-check-gave-up.en.mobile.light.view.png`; AUDIT §13:988-989, announcement ‘—’). Fix: mirror the `off` stage. Add `unverified` to `voice.errors` (types, with the comment `// Shown under the static example after the security check fails twice.`) and the content files: EN `The security check didn’t load, so the live demo can’t run here. The example above shows what TaskFlow does.` / ES `La comprobación de seguridad no se ha cargado, así que la demo en directo no puede funcionar aquí. El ejemplo de arriba muestra lo que hace TaskFlow.` / CA `La comprovació de seguretat no s’ha carregat, així que la demo en directe no pot funcionar aquí. L’exemple de dalt mostra què fa TaskFlow.` (reviewer's; list the Catalan in your notes for a native read). Suggested wiring, which reuses the off stage's focus path: `shownError` (`:281`) becomes `stage === "tries-used" ? "" : stage === "unverified" ? t.errors.unverified : error`; the top placement (`:729`) becomes `{stage !== "off" && stage !== "unverified" && alertBox}`; in the `unverified` block (`:1020-1028`) render `<VoiceExample …/>`, then `{alertBox}`, then the hand-over paragraph. The focus effect (`:362-379`) then moves focus to the alert (`errorMessage`) as it does for `off`. If `handOver` (`:244`, `:375`, `:1023`) then has no other user, remove the ref, its `tabIndex={-1}` and the `?? handOver.current` fallback (no dead code); keep the hand-over text. The `.voice-off` wrapper and its spacing stay as in the off stage.

WEB-724 (R1H-4) · After ‘Stop waiting’ / «Dejar de esperar» / «Deixa d’esperar», no message appears: the try the server counted shows in the badge (3 → 2), Try again is below the fold on a phone, and a screen reader hears only the capture heading (renders `voice-stop-waiting.en.mobile.light.view.png` vs `voice-waiting-10s`; AUDIT §13:1031-1032). Fix: in `submit`'s stopped branch (`:515-520`), `reason === "stop"` gets `t.errors.processing`, the existing string: EN `Still understanding. Try again in a moment; it won’t use another try.` / ES `Sigo entendiendo. Vuelve a probar en un momento; no gastará otro intento.` / CA `Encara ho estic entenent. Torna-ho a provar d’aquí a un moment; no gastarà cap altre intent.` It's true: the server keeps working on the request, and Try again resends it with the same `X-Request-Id`, which doesn't use another try. `"timeout"` keeps `t.errors.timeout`; `"close"` still returns before any message. Keep `retry: true`. Update the comment at `:515` to say Stop waiting shows the processing message. The alert takes focus through the existing effect, at the top of the panel.

Tests (held). Update the assertions this package changes: the copy table in `tests/ux-web-voice.spec.ts` gains `offlineOpening` and `unverified` in three languages; WEB-401's opening-offline case expects `offlineOpening` (the sending case still expects `offline`); WEB-403's gave-up test expects the new alert, focused, between the example and the hand-over; WEB-13's Stop waiting tests expect the processing alert. Update the two state descriptions in `tests/support/ux-voice.ts` (`voice-check-gave-up`: ‘… the static example, the reason under it, and the hand-over’; `voice-stop-waiting`: ‘… the text kept, the still-understanding message, and Try again’). `PAGES` in `tests/ux-renders.spec.ts` needs no new state.
